title: One Day Older, One Day Younger

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks a child aged 6-10 and an elder)

collection.description: A child wishes to be grown up and an elder wishes to be young for a day: swap for an afternoon, or tell each other the best part.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) wishes (subject.he/she) were grown up, so (subject.he/she) could stay up late and carry the big baskets. (friend), sitting next to (subject.him/her), says (friend.he/she) wishes (friend.he/she) were a child again for a day, so (friend.he/she) could run on the beach without (friend.his/her) knees complaining. They look at each other with the same idea at once.

choices.label: Tell Each Other the Best Part

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: For an afternoon they swap, in pretend. (subject) sits in (friend)'s spot, nods wisely, and complains about (subject.his/her) knees. (friend) runs, slowly and very carefully, a short way down the beach and back, shrieking like a child. They both agree that the other one has it easier, and neither of them wants to swap for real.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) tells (friend) the best part of being little: everything is still new. (friend) tells (subject) the best part of being old: nothing is in a hurry. They think about each other's answers for a while. "I'll keep mine for now," says (subject). "Me too," says (friend).
